notes.title: H2 · ALTERNATE OPENING
notes.text: My doctor put me on a GLP-1 and never once mentioned what it does to your gut. I had to find out from a Facebook group. Let me tell you what I learned.

notes.title: H3 · ALTERNATE OPENING
notes.text: I was two months into a GLP-1, dropping weight, and still waking up every morning feeling backed up and uncomfortable like nothing had moved. Let me tell you what I finally found out. Because nobody told me about it either.
